input.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions
input.rationale: Paragraph 4(a) auto-renews for successive 1-year terms with no non-renewal mechanic. The only for-any-reason exit requires ninety (90) days written notice and is available only "following the Initial Term", so the first renewal cannot be avoided and thereafter the effective exit window is 90 days, which fails the fallback element of a non-renewal notice window of no more than 60 days (the 12-month renewal term is not walk-away multi-year). We therefore insert a Customer-only right to decline renewal on at least sixty (60) days' prior written notice before the end of the then-current term, leaving the mutual termination, material-breach and insolvency rights untouched. Renewal is on existing terms with no price-increase mechanic (fees are a revenue share under an Exhibit), so the conditional 5% uplift cap is untriggered.

proposal.summary: Give Customer a non-renewal right on 60 days' prior written notice
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement auto-renews for successive 1-year terms with no non-renewal mechanic, so our only exit is the 90 days' notice right available after the Initial Term. We have added a Customer right to decline renewal on 60 days' prior written notice before the end of the then-current term, which is our fallback position; renewal pricing is unchanged, so no uplift cap is needed.

ops.oldText: The initial term of this Agreement shall be one (1) year from the Effective Date (the "Initial Term"). This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term").
ops.newText: The initial term of this Agreement shall be one (1) year from the Effective Date (the "Initial Term"). This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless Customer gives at least sixty (60) days' prior written notice of non-renewal before the end of the then-current term, or earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term").

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.
